record.title: llama.cpp v0.9.0 adds FP8 quantization and multi-sequence inference support
record.summary: The ggml-org/llama.cpp project published v0.9.0 at commit cd959ba on 4 November. The release lists OCP FP8 E4M3 support, a multi-sequence attention operation for unified KV caches, batched tensor-copy APIs, four additional model architectures and audio and server API updates. Maintainers describe the attention change as more efficient, but the inspected release notes provide no quantified benchmark or independent validation.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: The ggml-org/llama.cpp project published v0.9.0 at commit cd959ba on 4 November 2026. Its release entry lists support for OCP FP8 E4M3, a multi-sequence attention operation, a batched tensor-copy API, four added model architectures, and audio and server API changes.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: The release notes describe the new attention operation as making unified KV-cache inference more efficient for multiple sequences and restoring non-unified KV prefill performance; they report no quantified benchmark in the release entry.

claims.label: NOT_ESTABLISHED
claims.text: The inspected release materials do not establish independent correctness checks, hardware-specific performance gains, production adoption, or downstream impact for the listed changes.

evidence_gaps.description: The release features and efficiency statement were not independently built or tested in this activation.

brief.importance_rationale: If the release notes correspond to usable implementation changes, support for four additional model architectures and FP8 and multi-sequence KV updates can expand local inference choices and affect runtime selection. This event does not establish measured speed or production impact.
limitations: This is an upstream release-note account, not an independent source-code audit or local build.
